site.name: Crypto Fee & Transfer Index
site.tagline: What it costs to send USDT and BTC right now, and which exchange is cheapest to withdraw from.
site.footer_note: Informational only, not advice. Fees change by the minute. Global/local regulations and restrictions are subject to change and may delay/obstruct data accuracy. Always check the exchange before you send.
